name: app.R
content:
# risk-app/app.R
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

# --- assume d.risk and d.l.filt are loaded here ---
# e.g. readRDS or readxl::read_excel calls

# helper
make_combo_str <- function(club, sport, nw) {
  out <- character(length(club))
  for (i in seq_along(club)) {
    labs <- c("Club", "Sport", "NW")[c(club[i], sport[i], nw[i])]
    out[i] <- if (length(labs) == 0) "Keine" else paste(labs, collapse = "+")
  }
  out
}

risk_sets_summary <- d.risk |>
  filter(Component == "Run_v") |>
  mutate(
    Club = as.character(Club),
    Sport = as.character(Sport),
    NW = as.character(NW),
    Sex = as.character(Sex),
    set_Club  = Club  == "ja",
    set_Sport = Sport == "ja",
    set_NW    = NW    == "ja",
    combo_str = make_combo_str(set_Club, set_Sport, set_NW),
    Sex_label = case_when(
      Sex == "m" ~ "Jungen",
      Sex == "w" ~ "Mädchen",
      TRUE ~ Sex
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(combo_str))

risk_values <- d.l.filt |>
  filter(Component == "Run_v") |>
  mutate(
    Club = as.character(Club),
    Sport = as.character(Sport),
    Sex  = as.character(Sex),
    NW = case_when(
      BMI == "NW" ~ "ja",
      !is.na(BMI) ~ "nein",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    set_Club  = Club  == "ja",
    set_Sport = Sport == "ja",
    set_NW    = NW    == "ja",
    combo_str = make_combo_str(set_Club, set_Sport, set_NW),
    Sex_label = case_when(
      Sex == "m" ~ "Jungen",
      Sex == "w" ~ "Mädchen",
      TRUE ~ Sex
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(Sex), !is.na(NW), !is.na(combo_str))

all_combos <- sort(unique(risk_sets_summary$combo_str))

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Interaktive Risiko-Kombinationen"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      checkboxGroupInput(
        "club_sel", "Verein:",
        choices  = c("ja", "nein"),
        selected = c("ja", "nein")
      ),
      checkboxGroupInput(
        "sport_sel", "Sport-AG:",
        choices  = c("ja", "nein"),
        selected = c("ja", "nein")
      ),
      checkboxGroupInput(
        "nw_sel", "Normalgewicht:",
        choices  = c("ja", "nein"),
        selected = c("ja", "nein")
      ),
      checkboxGroupInput(
        "sex_sel", "Geschlecht:",
        choices  = c("m", "w"),
        selected = c("m", "w")
      ),
      selectizeInput(
        "combo_sel", "Kombination(en):",
        choices  = all_combos,
        selected = all_combos,
        multiple = TRUE
      ),
      checkboxInput("sort_desc", "Absteigend sortieren", FALSE)
    ),
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Medians",    plotOutput("median_plot",   height = "600px")),
        tabPanel("Verteilung", plotOutput("detail_plot",   height = "600px")),
        tabPanel("Tabelle",    tableOutput("summary_table"))
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  risk_summary_filt <- reactive({
    req(input$club_sel, input$sport_sel, input$nw_sel, input$sex_sel, input$combo_sel)

    risk_sets_summary |>
      filter(
        Club      %in% input$club_sel,
        Sport     %in% input$sport_sel,
        NW        %in% input$nw_sel,
        Sex       %in% input$sex_sel,
        combo_str %in% input$combo_sel
      )
  })

  risk_values_filt <- reactive({
    req(input$club_sel, input$sport_sel, input$nw_sel, input$sex_sel, input$combo_sel)

    risk_values |>
      filter(
        Club      %in% input$club_sel,
        Sport     %in% input$sport_sel,
        NW        %in% input$nw_sel,
        Sex       %in% input$sex_sel,
        combo_str %in% input$combo_sel
      )
  })

  output$median_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- risk_summary_filt()
    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "Keine Daten für diese Auswahl."))

    ord <- df |>
      group_by(combo_str) |>
      summarise(m = mean(median, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
      { if (isTRUE(input$sort_desc)) arrange(., desc(m)) else arrange(., m) }

    df <- df |>
      mutate(combo_str = factor(combo_str, levels = ord$combo_str))

    ggplot(df, aes(x = combo_str, y = median, colour = Sex_label, group = Sex_label)) +
      geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 2) +
      geom_errorbar(
        aes(ymin = lwr.ci, ymax = upr.ci),
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
        width = 0.2
      ) +
      labs(
        x      = "Risikokombination",
        y      = "6-Minuten-Lauf (m/s)",
        colour = "Geschlecht"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  })

  output$detail_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- risk_values_filt()
    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "Keine Daten für diese Auswahl."))

    ord <- df |>
      group_by(combo_str) |>
      summarise(m = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
      { if (isTRUE(input$sort_desc)) arrange(., desc(m)) else arrange(., m) }

    df <- df |>
      mutate(combo_str = factor(combo_str, levels = ord$combo_str))

    ggplot(df, aes(x = combo_str, y = value, fill = Sex_label)) +
      geom_violin(
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
        trim     = FALSE,
        alpha    = 0.35
      ) +
      geom_boxplot(
        position      = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
        width         = 0.15,
        outlier.alpha = 0.15
      ) +
      labs(
        x    = "Risikokombination",
        y    = "6-Minuten-Lauf (m/s)",
        fill = "Geschlecht"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  })

  output$summary_table <- renderTable({
    df <- risk_summary_filt()
    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "Keine Daten für diese Auswahl."))

    df |>
      select(combo_str, Sex_label, median, lwr.ci, upr.ci, N) |>
      arrange(combo_str, Sex_label)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
